about: Approximate hub positions on the round 5 hero pick (valley-isometric-b), as fractions of the SOURCE image width (x) and height (y), origin top-left. Each point sits on the lit landmark nearest the real town in the render (towers for SF and San Jose, glowing campus blocks down the peninsula). The render is a stylised model, so spacing is the picture's, not the map's. Eyeballed on a 5 % grid, good to about +/- 0.01.
crop_note: The hero uses object-cover, so convert to on-screen positions per crop. Desktop 1440 x 720 box over a 16:9 image (1440 x 810): screen_y = (y * 810 - 45) / 720, x unchanged. Phone 390 x 520 image box over a 4:5 image (416 x 520): screen_x = (x * 416 - 13) / 390, y unchanged. Recompute for other box sizes the same way.
wordmark_note: San Jose sits at the far end of the bay, right under the bottom edge of the wordmark on both crops (desktop wordmark spans about x 0.41-0.59, y 0.19-0.38 of the 16:9 image; phone about x 0.30-0.70, y 0.16-0.34 of the 4:5). Keep any San Jose light small and soft, or let it be the horizon glow that already backlights the mark.
